primary_provisions.NDS3.10.2: Compression perpendicular to grain uses actual stress based on net bearing area compared with adjusted Fc_perp.
primary_provisions.NDS3.10.4: Bearing-area enhancement optional for bearing length<6in and not nearer than3in to member end. Cb=(lb+.375)/lb, roundwasher lb=diameter.
primary_provisions.NDS2.3.2: No duration enhancement for deformation-limited Fc_perp.
primary_provisions.NDS12.1.3.3: Standard cut washer or equal-or-larger metalplate/strap between wood and head/nut; this is not a substitute for metal design.
primary_provisions.NDS2024SupplementTable4A: Dry dimension lumber DFLNo2 declared basis Fc_perp625psi,Fc1350psi. Subject to actual species/grade/service confirmation.

proposed_conditional_calculation.net_annulus_mm2: pi/4*(OD^2-max(washer_ID,wood_bore_diameter)^2) for concentric full untruncated supported footprint; subtract any additional unsupported wood area. Washer-ID-only annulus is upper area/lower mean-stress diagnostic if wood bore is larger.
proposed_conditional_calculation.compression_force_N: actual field-derived head/nut compression with correct sign; excludes unknown installation preload
proposed_conditional_calculation.index: (N/A)/(625psi); Cb1, CD not applied, remaining service assumptions declared
proposed_conditional_calculation.oblique: 625psi baseline is no greater than Hankinson value between Fc1350 andFcperp625, but it does not qualify shear/contact details
proposed_conditional_calculation.plywood: No plywood Fcperp invented. Exclude from sawnwood625 criterion.

applicability_limits: Average full-annulus pressure is not a bound on peak contact stress.
Unknown preload adds compression and cannot be silently zeroed for hardware acceptance.
Footprint truncation, nearby bores/edges, grain flaws and actual seats must be checked.
Washer bending, punching, head/nut/steel strength, tolerances and actual contact state remain separate.
Numerical comparison cannot release the connection.

scalar_Z_limit.rear: Two adjacent wood intervals establish a possible single-shear topology, but field contains simultaneous unequal distributed force, free couples, axial action and group moment. A scalar P/Z comparison alone discards independently prescribed moment/axial demands unless an explicit equivalence or conservative wrench envelope is proved. Standard plastic yield-bearing patterns need not equal prescribed affine elastic pressures.
scalar_Z_limit.cleat: Three unequal wood-plywood-steel media and unequal side lengths/materials are not symmetric double shear. No unsupported doubling or favorable main/side assignment. Need generalized actual multibody yield/interaction plus independent metal and axial transfer checks.
scalar_Z_limit.status: No complete yield work or Z pass claimed.
